sentences.text: Revenue compounded at 14.7% a year from $96.6 billion in FY2017 to $331.8 billion in FY2026 [F1][F10][F221].
The path was a steady climb rather than a step change: growth held between 6.9% and 18.0% every year, with the FY2023 slowdown to 6.9% the only dip below double digits [D311][D258][D472].

FY2026 was the largest move, revenue up 17.8% on growth in Microsoft Cloud, with Intelligent Cloud driven by Azure and Productivity and Business Processes by Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud [D472][P17].
The FY2018 net income fall of 35.0% was a tax event, not an operating one, as the TCJA net charge hit that year's effective rate of 54.6% [D48][D32][P61].
Microsoft Cloud supplied 16.2pp of the 17.8% revenue growth in FY2026 and reached 64.6% of revenue [D568][D472][D566].
Server products and cloud services added 11.0pp, as Azure and other cloud services grew 41% on demand across all workloads [D642][P12].
Microsoft 365 Commercial products and cloud services contributed 5.1pp on 16.2% growth, with cloud revenue up 17% on Copilot and E5 [D649][D648][P14].
Operating costs grew 7.4% against revenue growth of 17.8%, so operating costs grew 10.3pp slower than revenue [D491][D472][D499].
Incremental operating margin was 53.3% in FY2026, and diluted EPS grew 31.6% against net income growth of 31.3% as the diluted share count fell 0.2% [D498][D476][D474][D493].
Operating margin reached 46.8% in FY2026, a window high against a 41.7% median and a 30.1% low in FY2017 [F50][D974][D975][D973].
Gross margin slipped 0.9pp to 67.9%, below its 68.2% median and 69.8% high, as cost of revenue took 0.9pp off operating margin [F30][D486][D981][D980][D500].
Intelligent Cloud gross margin percentage fell on continued AI infrastructure investment and sales mix shift to Azure, offset in part by Azure efficiency gains [P11].
In FY2026 net margin of 40.3% sat 6.5pp below the 46.8% operating margin, narrowed by $10.7 billion of other income including OpenAI gains [F70][F50][X124][P7].
Operating cash flow of $182.9 billion was 1.37x net income, in line with the 1.34x of FY2025 [F100][D459][D405].
Cash from operations rose $46.8 billion primarily on higher cash received from customers and lower income tax payments [P1].
Free cash flow fell 6.5% to $67.0 billion, a 20.2% margin and window low, as capex of $115.9 billion reached 34.9% of revenue and 3.38x D&A [F120][D478][D456][D982][F110][D455][D461].
Cash used in investing rose $66.9 billion, primarily a $51.4 billion increase in property and equipment additions [P1].
Net cash of $72.9 billion was 22.0% of revenue, the 83rd percentile of six software peers against a -7.2% median [D465][D466][D1006][D1007].
Total debt fell to $40.3 billion while cash and investments held at $113.2 billion, and the current ratio of 1.23x is a window low [D464][D463][F200][D991].
Buybacks of $22.3 billion plus dividends of $26.4 billion absorbed 72.7% of free cash flow, and the diluted share count fell 0.2% [X147][X157][D468][D493].
The balance sheet remains a cushion, but the rising capex share of free cash flow is the constraint on future capital return.
Free cash flow ran below 80% of net income in FY2025 and FY2026, at 0.70x and 0.50x, the window low [R1][D406][D460][D988].
The gap is capex-driven rather than an earnings-quality problem, but it leaves free cash flow margin at the 20th percentile of five peers against a 34.7% median [D1002][D1003].
FY2017 pretax income, income tax and receivables were later restated, and the pack uses first-reported values [R2][R3][R4][X95][X105][X213].
Those recasts affect only FY2017 comparisons and do not change the trend conclusions drawn from later years.
Capex at 34.9% of revenue in FY2026 against the 22.9% of FY2025, reported in the FY2027 10-K, would confirm or reverse the free-cash-flow squeeze [D455][D401].
Free cash flow margin at 20.2% against the 30.3% window median, in the FY2027 10-K, would show whether conversion recovers [D456][D984].
Operating margin at 46.8% against the 41.7% median, in the FY2027 10-K, would test whether AI infrastructure costs erode the current high [F50][D975].
